Why us

What we actually do

Six things worth knowing before you pick a card.

The right card, not the popular one

Your salary and where your money goes decide which card pays off. A travel card is useless if you never fly.

We work in six languages

Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Hindi, English. Ask about any card in whichever one you think in.

Fewer rejections

Every rejected application sits on your credit record. We check the bank’s income rules first so you apply where you qualify.

We are an HDFC Bank DSA

HDFC Bank applications go through us, straight into the bank’s own system. For other banks, we help you choose and show you how to apply on the bank’s own website. We never handle your card or your money.

Getting your money back out

Most people never redeem their points. We show you how the cashback, rewards and lounge access on your card actually work.

We stay reachable after

Approval is not the end. Track the status, sort out activation, ask us when something on the statement looks wrong.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 28 October 2026

We are an independent advisory service for credit cards and loans, and an authorised Direct Selling Agent (DSA) of HDFC Bank. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, where it is kept, and what rights you have. It is written to meet our obligations under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

1. What we collect

Only what you type into the forms on this site:

  • Your name and mobile number
  • Your city and age
  • Your monthly income range and employment type
  • Your preferred language
  • For a card enquiry, your main spending category
  • For a loan enquiry, the type of loan and the amount you need
  • If you use our contact form, how to reply to you and your message

We never ask for your PAN, Aadhaar, bank account details or passwords on this site. We do not use cookies to track you, and we do not run analytics or advertising trackers on this site. If we ever add visitor analytics, we will say so here first.

2. Why we collect it

To recommend credit cards or loans that suit your profile, to contact you about your enquiry, and, if you decide to apply, to help with your application. Income and employment type are needed because banks set minimum eligibility rules, and recommending something you cannot qualify for wastes your time and can leave a rejection on your credit record.

3. Where it is kept, and who we share it with

When you send a form, your details are stored in our accounts with the service providers we use to run this site and follow up with you:

  • Netlify, which hosts this website and receives the forms
  • Google (Google Sheets and Gmail), where we keep our list of enquiries and receive a copy by email
  • Our own lead-tracking tool, where we note how your enquiry is progressing

These providers may store data on servers outside India.

If you decide to apply, your details are shared with the bank or card issuer you choose, and with that bank's authorised processing partners, solely to process your application.

We do not sell your data. We do not share it with unrelated third parties, data brokers, marketers, or other lenders you did not ask about.

4. Consent

We only act on your data after you tick the consent box on one of our forms or send us a message through our contact form. You can withdraw consent at any time through our contact form. Withdrawing consent stops any future processing, but cannot reverse an application already submitted to a bank, as that then falls under the bank's own privacy policy.

5. How long we keep it

Enquiry details are kept for up to 12 months so we can follow up on your application and answer questions about it. After that they are deleted. If you ask us to delete them sooner, we will.

6. Your rights

  • Ask what data of yours we hold
  • Ask us to correct anything wrong
  • Ask us to delete your data
  • Withdraw your consent
  • Nominate someone to exercise these rights if you cannot
  • Raise a grievance with us, and escalate to the Data Protection Board of India if unsatisfied

We respond to these requests within 30 days.

7. Security

Your details are kept only in the accounts listed in section 3, which are protected by passwords, and on our own devices, which are protected by device locks. Access to them is limited to us.

8. Card and loan information on this site

Card fees, features and benefits, and loan rates and fees, are taken from official bank websites and were accurate when last checked. Banks change terms without notice. Always confirm details on the bank's own website before applying. We are not liable for a bank's decision to approve or reject an application.

9. Children

Our service is for adults aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18.

10. Raise a request or complaint

To ask what data we hold, correct it, delete it, withdraw consent, or raise a complaint, send us a message here. It reaches our Grievance Officer directly.

We respond within 30 days. If we do not resolve it, you may escalate to the Data Protection Board of India.

This policy is published in English so that its legal meaning stays exact and is not altered by translation.

Contact us

Send us a message and we will get back to you.
